question: Aryabhatta was India's first artificial satellite in space, launched in the year ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aryabhatta **was **India's first satellite** in space, launched in the** year 1975** by the **Soviet Union.**
 
• It was named after the **famous Indian mathematician Aryabhatta **who made significant contributions to the **field of astronomy.**
 
• The satellite was designed to** study X-rays, gamma rays, and cosmic rays** and to conduct experiments in **solar physics.**
 
• It orbited the Earth for** four years** before re-entering the atmosphere and burning up.
 
• **Option 1**, 1925, is** incorrect **as India did not have the capability to launch satellites in that year.
 
• **Option 2**, 1990, is also** incorrect** as India launched its first satellite, Aryabhata, in 1975.
 
• **Option 4**, 1945, is **incorrect **as India did not have any satellite launch capabilities during that time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The launch of Aryabhatta marked India's entry into the** field of space research and technology.**
 
• The satellite weighed **360 kg **and was placed in a **near-Earth orbit** at an altitude of** 619 km.**
 
• The success of Aryabhatta paved the way for the development of India's space program, which has since launched **numerous satellites** for a variety of applications.
 
• India's first satellite, Aryabhata, was named after the **same mathematician**, but it was launched by India in **1975.**
